scope: Approved repository code/docs and synthetic board/memory only. No production data or model downloads.
embedding_protocol: Pinned offline Gemma, 768 dimensions, production token windows and title template, batched document preparation and three-kind reference checks. Every public record encoded; identical-text forbidden clones reuse its vector.
measured_query_encoder: Unchanged production Gemma.query, no query embedding cache

cold.scope: Fresh SQLite connections, one query each from code/board/memory
cold.model: Resident; startup separately recorded, first semantic query may include lazy initialization
cold.connection_setup: Reported separately; wall time includes setup and cleanup

load.pattern: Closed loop, round-robin query/mode mix; no independent arrival-rate claim
load.drain: Wall time includes finishing in-flight work
load.budget: Production soft 20-second search deadline; partial results counted as failures of completeness

admission_checks: All 10k authorized records scanned; no private/foreign/expired/disputed results or duplicate IDs; no fallback, deadline or scan truncation accepted as complete
ranking_depth: Unchanged production default 4096; ranking-window truncation explicitly reported, not treated as incomplete candidate scanning
ranking_policy: Unchanged equal-weight RRF k=60, lexical OR-term matching; no tuning on existing or forthcoming labels
hybrid_analysis: Per-query lexical/semantic ranks and RRF contributions, known-anchor demotions, per-domain provisional metrics
review: Rank-blind deterministic-shuffled union of mode top-10 and known anchors; no mode/rank/old grades, opaque per-query candidate IDs, mapping hash pinned. Reviewer independence can only be declared, not identity verified.
metrics_limit: Existing assistant-authored positives are provisional anchors; capacity distractors unjudged. Subsequent human scoring is pooled, not exhaustive 10k recall.
